description_en: Creates a server group for a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
description_zh: 创建负载均衡服务器组
name: CreateServerGroup

parameters.help_en:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

Instance (default): allows you to specify resources of the Ecs, Eni, or Eci type.

Ip: allows you to add servers by specifying their IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组类型。取值：

Instance（默认值）：服务器类型，该类型服务器组支持添加Ecs、Eni、Eci类型实例。

Ip：IP地址类型，该类型服务器组支持直接添加IP地址类型的后端服务器
parameters.name: server_group_type

parameters.help_en:
The server group name.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: server_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The backend protocol. Valid value:

GENEVE (default)
parameters.help_zh:
后端转发协议。取值：

GENEVE（默认值）
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

5TCH (default): specifies consistent hashing that is based on the following factors: source IP address, destination IP address, source port, protocol, and destination port. Requests that contain the same information based on the preceding factors are forwarded to the same backend server.

3TCH: specifies consistent hashing that is based on the following factors: source IP address, destination IP address, and protocol. Requests that contain the same information based on the preceding factors are forwarded to the same backend server.

2TCH: specifies consistent hashing that is based on the following factors: source IP address and destination IP address. Requests that contain the same information based on the preceding factors are forwarded to the same backend server
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

5TCH（默认值）：五元组哈希，基于五元组（源IP、目的IP、源端口、目的端口和协议）的一致性哈希，相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器。

3TCH：三元组哈希，基于三元组（源IP、目的IP和协议）的一致性哈希，相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器。

2TCH：二元组哈希，基于二元组（源IP和目的IP）的一致性哈希，相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
Specifies how GWLB processes requests over existing connections when a backend server is not running as expected. Valid values:

NoRebalance (default): GWLB continues to forward requests over existing connections to the unavailable backend server.

Rebalance: GWLB forwards requests over existing connections to the remaining healthy backend servers
parameters.help_zh:
服务器异常时，存量流量的处理方式。取值：

NoRebalance（默认值）：不重新平衡现有流量。
Rebalance：重新平衡现有流量
parameters.name: server_failover_mode

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID.

If ServerGroupType is set to Instance, only servers in the specified VPC can be added to the server group
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例ID。

如果ServerGroupType取值为Instance时，只有该VPC下的服务器可以加入到该服务器组
parameters.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable connection draining. Valid values:

true

false
fields.help_zh:
是否开启连接优雅中断。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
fields.name: connection_drain_enabled

fields.help_en:
The timeout period of connection draining.

Unit: seconds

Valid values: 1 to 3600.

Default value: 300
fields.help_zh:
连接优雅中断超时时间。

单位：秒。

取值范围：1~3600。

默认值：300
fields.name: connection_drain_timeout

parameters.help_zh: 连接优雅中断相关配置
parameters.name: connection_drain_config

fields.help_en:
The backend server port used for health checks.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

Default value: 80
fields.help_zh:
健康检查使用的后端服务器的端口。

取值范围： 1~65535。

默认值：80
fields.name: health_check_connect_port

fields.help_en:
The maximum timeout period for a health check response.

Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 300.

Default value: 5
fields.help_zh:
健康检查响应的最大超时时间。

单位：秒。

取值范围：1~300。

默认值：5
fields.name: health_check_connect_timeout

fields.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks. Valid values:

$SERVER_IP (default): the private IP address of a backend server.

domain: a domain name. The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and periods (.).

This parameter takes effect only if you set HealthCheckProtocol to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。取值：

$SERVER_IP（默认值）：使用后端服务器内网IP。

domain：指定特定域名。长度限制1~80个字符，只能使用大小写字母、数字、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）。

仅HealthCheckProtocol为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_domain

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:

true (default)

false
fields.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查，取值：

true（默认值）：开启。

false：关闭
fields.name: health_check_enabled

fields.help_en: The HTTP status codes that the system returns for health checks
fields.name: health_check_http_code

fields.help_en:
The interval at which health checks are performed.

Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。

单位：秒。

取值范围：1~50。

默认值：10
fields.name: health_check_interval

fields.help_en:
The path used for health checks.

It must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), question marks (?), number signs (#), and ampersands (&). The URL can also contain the following extended characters: _ ; \~ ! ( ) * [ ] @ $ ^ : ' , + =

It must start with a forward slash (/).

This parameter takes effect only if you set HealthCheckProtocol to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查路径。

长度为1~80个字符，只能使用大小写英文字母、数字和短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、百分号（%）、半角问号（?）、井号（#）和and（&）以及扩展字符集_;~!()*[]@$^:',+=

必须以正斜线（/）开头。
仅HealthCheckProtocol为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_path

fields.help_en:
The protocol used for health checks. Valid values:

TCP (default): GWLB performs TCP health checks by sending SYN packets to a backend server to check whether the port of the backend server is available to receive requests.

HTTP: GWLB performs HTTP health checks to check whether backend servers are healthy by sending GET requests which simulate access from browsers
fields.help_zh:
健康检查协议，取值：

TCP（默认值）：通过发送SYN握手报文来检测服务器端口是否存活。

HTTP：通过发送GET请求模拟浏览器的访问行为来检查服务器应用是否健康
fields.name: health_check_protocol

fields.help_en:
The number of times that an unhealthy backend server must consecutively pass health checks before it is declared healthy. In this case, the health check status of the backend server changes from fail to success.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 2
fields.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由失败判定为成功。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：2
fields.name: healthy_threshold

fields.help_en:
The number of times that a healthy backend server must consecutively fail health checks before it is declared unhealthy. In this case, the health check status of the backend server changes from success to fail.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 2
fields.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由成功判定为失败。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：2
fields.name: unhealthy_threshold

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag keys.

You can specify at most 20 tags in each call
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

一次调用最多支持 20 个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建服务器组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
